finding_note: Records a REASONING error caught this cycle, because the error is more portable than the fix. The engineer skipped a pre-push rebase on the inference 'nothing has merged because CI is stalled, so the base cannot have moved'. That inference is FALSE and I verified it independently rather than inheriting either PM's claim or the engineer's: all six SHAs PM named (5bd2997, 72ea593, 15cef6e, 7e7d94b, 6cec12f, 3d177eb) are ancestors of origin/main, so main moved six times while zero CI runs executed. Merges are not gated on CI in this repository, so CI liveness says nothing about base movement. The operational conclusion — skip the rebase — is still right, but for a different reason I checked myself: main's delta (check-mutation-audit.mjs plus fourteen audit rows) is FILE-DISJOINT from this PR's surface (the compatibility-contract guard, its test, and the two contract documents), and it crosses none of the declared cross-language boundaries, so the branch being six behind cannot affect what I measured. Right answer, wrong reason, and the wrong reason would have failed on a base that overlapped.
